name: Pierre Du Mans
features: light skin, dark brown hair, green eyes, French features, slim athletic build, refined features, thin mustache, sophisticated expression
bio:
A sophisticated French driver born in the legendary racing city of Le Mans. Pierre's destiny was written from birth, and his endurance racing skills honor his hometown's heritage.

Proudly carrying his homeland in his name, he turns himself into a super champion when he's on La Sarthe's asphalt. Something happens inside him and makes him fly.
